2026-09-22T09:42:33.0989511Z temporary_id: optional cross-reference field for future resources created by safe outputs. Use this form for all field values (temporary_id, item_number, issue_number, parent, etc.). In body/markdown text, '#aw_abc1' references are replaced with the real issue/PR number after creation. 2026-09-22T09:42:33.1048145Z For `safeoutputs`, every successful call is a real write-intent declaration - do not use it for probing, auth checks, or placeholder payloads. Use `noop` or `report_incomplete` if not ready to emit the final action.
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1050733Z 
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1051637Z For multiple or complex arguments, pipe a JSON object on stdin using `.` as the sentinel:
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1053220Z ```bash
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1054400Z printf '{"item_number":42,"body":"### Title\n\nBody."}' | safeoutputs add_comment .
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1056220Z # or write to a file: safeoutputs create_pull_request . < /tmp/payload.json
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1057785Z ```
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1058206Z 
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1063900Z **Multi-line or long `body` content:** do NOT build the JSON payload with `printf`/`echo` embedding raw newlines or many escaped characters directly in the command line — the sandbox's shell command-injection guard may reject long or complex quoted arguments (reporting "expansion patterns"/"command substitution" even though none are present) and retrying the identical command will fail again. Instead, write the content to a temp file with a heredoc, then use `jq -Rs` to inject it as the `body` field:
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1071352Z ```bash
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1072205Z cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/gh-aw/body.md
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1073183Z Title
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1073612Z 
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1074029Z Multi-line body content goes here.
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1075018Z EOF
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1076213Z jq -Rs '{title: "My title", body: .}' /tmp/gh-aw/body.md | safeoutputs create_discussion .
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1077928Z ```
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1079976Z If a shell command is rejected for containing expansion patterns, do not retry the same command — switch to the heredoc + `jq -Rs` pattern above.
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1081819Z 
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1083031Z To inject an entire local file as the `body` field without re-embedding its content in the model context, use `jq -Rs`:
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1084910Z ```bash
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1085860Z jq -Rs --arg discussion_number "$DISCUSSION_NUMBER" \
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1087487Z   '{discussion_number: ($discussion_number|tonumber), body: .}' \
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1088831Z   discussion-body.md \
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1089785Z   | safeoutputs update_discussion .
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1090794Z ```
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1094003Z `jq -Rs` reads the file as a raw string (`-R`) and slurps it into a single JSON string value (`-s`), so `body` is always a valid JSON field. Piping `cat file | safeoutputs ...` does not populate `body` and will be rejected.
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1096540Z
